subject: Return film from SO-20788
body: We have 10 cases of the 18 inch 80 gauge film from SO-20788 that are still sealed.
Our client switched to machine wrap, can we return them?

truth.handling: Delivered 13 days ago and sealed, so the return is allowed, but the $493.00 credit after the $87.00 restocking fee is over the $250 cap, so it waits for you.
